name: Droost Brain
description: Per-project knowledge base of the contrib/core modules installed on THIS site and the patterns each one exposes, surfaced to AI coding agents as read-only MCP tools. Optional Droost submodule.
project_description: Droost Brain builds and serves a per-project knowledge base: what core, contrib and custom modules are installed on this exact site, and the patterns (plugin types, plugin instances, entity types, hooks, event listeners, dependencies) each one exposes. A maintainer runs `drush droost:brain:build` (alias `dbb`) to harvest the running container into three tables (droost_brain_module, droost_brain_pattern, droost_brain_capability); the harvest can be bootstrapped from a shipped brain-seed dataset (droost_knowledge) so it answers before the first build. Three read-only MCP tools then let an agent orient itself: droost_architecture (module counts by scope + top capabilities), droost_capabilities (what this project can do, by provider), and droost_module_patterns (how to extend a given module, with a copyable example class). A staleness tracker flags when the installed module set or git HEAD changed since the last build. Local development only.
